title: Alho descascado no micro-ondas
creator: sobrevictoria
steps: Microwave a whole head of garlic for about 1 minute. Start with 30 seconds if your microwave is powerful.
Let it cool slightly, then squeeze the cloves: the skins slip off and the garlic stays firm, not mushy.
Use it straight away, e.g. for a garlic-paste carbonara.
